items.text: HE LUNGES FOR THE DOOR AND HITS A BUTTON. THEN HE TURNS AND FACES THE PARTY WITH SWORD DRAWN. 'IN A MOMENT A PATROL WILL BE HERE. IF YOU STAY TO FIGHT ME YOU WILL DIE.'

items.text: YOU ARE IN A HALL WITH LONG TABLES, BENCHES AND A GREAT HEARTH AT ONE END. IN THE CORNERS ARE HEAPS OF GARBAGE BEING PICKED OVER BY SOME RATS WHICH FLEE AT YOUR ENTRANCE.
